title: Your dog, as a portrait
mechanism: Test whether the real framed portrait and the note from the dog earn saves and sends from people shopping for a dog owner.

scenes.headline: Your dog, as a portrait.
scenes.text: Painted from one photo of your dog.

scenes.headline: And a short note from the dog.
scenes.text: It comes in the box, signed with a paw.

scenes.headline: Framed in black, white or red oak.
scenes.text: Who would your dog give this to?
